description_en: You can invoke QueryTaskInfoHistory to perform a paged query of the domain name job history list under your account.
description_zh: 调用QueryTaskInfoHistory分页查询自己账户下的域名任务历史列表
kebab_example: aliyun domain query-task-info-history --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --begin-create-time 1522080000000 --end-create-time 1522080000000 --page-size 2 --create-time-cursor 1522080000000 --task-no-cursor aa634d3f-927e-4d17-9d2c-test --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTaskInfoHistory

parameters.help_en: User IP address, which can be set to 127.0.0.1.
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
Language for API error messages. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese  
en: English  

Default value is en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Start time of the creation date range for the query, expressed as the number of milliseconds since 00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Currently supports queries by day only.
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建日期范围的开始时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数，目前只支持按天查询
parameters.name: begin_create_time

parameters.help_en: End time of the creation date range for the query, expressed as the number of milliseconds since 00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970. Currently supports queries by day only.
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建日期范围的结束时间，UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数，目前只支持按天查询
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_zh: 创建日期的游标（技术参数）
parameters.name: create_time_cursor

parameters.help_en: Job cursor; pass in the job number from the corresponding page cursor during pagination (technical parameter).
parameters.help_zh: 任务光标，翻页时传入对应页游标中的任务编号（技术参数）
parameters.name: task_no_cursor
